verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own docs say the mailbox handles shipments and returns, and that packages can be shipped to any address with savings when bundled. That covers forwarding and a form of consolidation. Missing for 10: evidence that packages from all major carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL, USPS) are accepted, documented hold-for-pickup, details on how consolidation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a digital nomad, the address accepts packages from all major carriers and can consolidate or hold them for pickup or forwarding
